SELECT c.name AS customer_name, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
WHERE c.region = '서울'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.sales
WHERE quarter = '2025-Q3'

SELECT AVG(s.amount) AS avg_monthly_sales
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category = 'security'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.contracts WHERE status = 'active'

SELECT e.name, e.salary 
FROM companyx.employees e 
JOIN companyx.departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id 
WHERE d.name = '기술지원팀'

SELECT c.name AS client_name, COUNT(p.id) AS project_count
FROM companyx.clients c
JOIN companyx.projects p ON c.id = p.client_id
WHERE p.status = 'in_progress'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY project_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT st.id, st.title, st.description, st.priority, st.status, c.name AS client_name, p.name AS product_name, e.name AS assignee_name
FROM companyx.support_tickets st
JOIN companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id
JOIN companyx.products p ON st.product_id = p.id
JOIN companyx.employees e ON st.assignee_id = e.id
WHERE st.priority = 'critical' AND st.status = 'open'

SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(c.amount) AS total_amount
FROM companyx.products p
JOIN companyx.contracts c ON p.id = c.product_id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.clients WHERE registered_at BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'

SELECT d.name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary
FROM companyx.departments d
JOIN companyx.employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id
GROUP BY d.name
ORDER BY avg_salary DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id
WHERE c.region = '부산' AND s.quarter = '2025-Q3'

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'security' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'cloud' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) THEN '보안'
        ELSE '클라우드'
    END AS category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'security' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS security_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'cloud' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS cloud_sales
FROM 
    companyx.sales s
JOIN 
    companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id
JOIN 
    companyx.contracts c ON s.contract_id = c.id
JOIN 
    companyx.clients cl ON s.client_id = cl.id
WHERE 
    p.category IN ('security', 'cloud') 
    AND cl.region = '대전' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_date) = 2025
SELECT (SELECT price_monthly FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-D1') - (SELECT price_monthly FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-D2') AS price_difference
SELECT name, version, release_date FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-C4'

SELECT c.name AS client_name, c.contact_name, c.contact_email
FROM companyx.clients c
WHERE c.id = (SELECT id FROM companyx.clients WHERE name = 'Client-N')
SELECT e.name, e.hire_date FROM companyx.employees e WHERE e.hire_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-07-31'

SELECT e.name, e.salary
FROM companyx.employees e
WHERE e.salary BETWEEN 4000 AND 5000 AND e.is_active = true

SELECT st.title, st.created_at, c.name AS client_name
FROM companyx.support_tickets st
JOIN companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id
WHERE st.priority = 'critical' AND st.status = 'open'

SELECT 
    c.name AS client_name,
    p.name AS product_name,
    e.name AS assignee_name,
    st.title,
    st.description,
    st.priority,
    st.status,
    st.created_at,
    st.resolved_at
FROM 
    companyx.support_tickets st
JOIN 
    companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id
JOIN 
    companyx.products p ON st.product_id = p.id
JOIN 
    companyx.employees e ON st.assignee_id = e.id
WHERE 
    c.name = 'Client-X' AND st.status = 'resolved'

SELECT st.title, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) AS time_taken
FROM companyx.support_tickets st
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM st.created_at) = 2025 AND st.status = 'resolved'
ORDER BY time_taken DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.name AS client_name, co.end_date
FROM companyx.contracts co
JOIN companyx.clients c ON co.client_id = c.id
WHERE co.end_date = '2026-10-01' AND co.status = 'active'

SELECT p.name AS product_name, c.amount, c.start_date, c.end_date
FROM companyx.contracts c
JOIN companyx.products p ON c.product_id = p.id
WHERE c.contract_type = 'subscription'

SELECT p.budget, p.start_date
FROM companyx.projects p
JOIN companyx.clients c ON p.client_id = c.id
JOIN companyx.products pr ON p.product_id = pr.id
WHERE c.name = 'Client-E' AND pr.name = '로그 분석 시스템'
SELECT name FROM companyx.projects WHERE status = 'on_hold' AND end_date IS NULL

SELECT c.name AS client_name, c.region
FROM companyx.clients c
WHERE c.industry = 'medical/biotech'

SELECT c.name AS client_name, c.registered_at
FROM companyx.clients c
ORDER BY c.registered_at ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.sale_date, s.amount 
FROM companyx.sales s 
JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id 
WHERE p.name = 'Product-S2' AND s.quarter = '2025-Q1'

SELECT e.name AS employee_name, e.salary, e.hire_date
FROM companyx.employees e
WHERE e.name = '김준혁'

SELECT 
    contract_type, 
    COUNT(*) AS cancelled_contracts
FROM 
    companyx.contracts
WHERE 
    start_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' 
    AND status = 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    contract_type

SELECT 
    s.quarter, 
    SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount
FROM 
    companyx.sales s
JOIN 
    companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
WHERE 
    c.region = '서울' 
    AND s.quarter LIKE '2026-Q1%'
GROUP BY 
    s.quarter
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC
LIMIT 1
